helpful: Provisioned petition.txt carried the full Second Circuit summary order as an appendix, which was the single most important input: it showed the de novo recital and the substantial-evidence posture the petition elides

gaps: fedcourts query with --court scotus --era 2020s --disposition granted ranked nine emergency applications (26A dockets) in its top twelve despite the default application screen, so it surfaced no cert-petition prior comparable to this case; a caption-text or respondent-type filter would have helped
CourtListener's docket index returned zero SCOTUS dockets for NLRB-captioned cases since 2024, so there was no way to check how comparable post-Loper Bright NLRB petitions were disposed of

notes: Single corpus query (41 GETs, ~10.7 MB) plus five MCP searches; three of the five MCP searches returned nothing. Everything load-bearing came from the provisioned petition and the committed statpack.
